steps.label: doc-fixture-0
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE DocDeltaNodes (Id INT64 NOT NULL, Label STRING(MAX) NOT NULL, Properties JSON) PRIMARY KEY(Id)

steps.label: doc-fixture-1
steps.sql: CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH DocDeltaGraph NODE TABLES (DocDeltaNodes LABEL Node PROPERTIES(Id))

steps.label: doc-fixture-2
steps.sql: CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH DocDeltaDynamic NODE TABLES (DocDeltaNodes DYNAMIC LABEL(Label) DYNAMIC PROPERTIES(Properties))

steps.label: dynamic-order-repeat-1
